title: Affordable multi-family rental housing; redevelopment.
bodyText: After issuing a special management area use permit pursuant [to] section 205A-29.5, the county planning department in the respective county and any other state or county agency authorized to issue a permit or approval shall prioritize approving permits to redevelop the permanent affordable multi-family rental housing.
bodyHtml: [§201H-24]  Affordable multi-family rental housing; redevelopment.  After issuing a special management area use permit pursuant [to] section 205A-29.5, the county planning department in the respective county and any other state or county agency authorized to issue a permit or approval shall prioritize approving permits to redevelop the permanent affordable multi-family rental housing. [L 2025, c 313, §3]
